title: Samson's Birth
description: The angel of the Lord appears to Manoah's barren wife and announces that she will give birth to a son who will be a Nazarite and begin to deliver Israel from the Philistines. The angel appears again to both spouses and ascends in the flame from the altar. The woman gives birth to Samson, and the Spirit of the Lord begins to stir him.

versions.title: Samson's Birth
versions.description: An angel announces the birth of Samson. He will be a Nazarite and begin to deliver Israel.
